description: Machine-readable policy for the 50PLUS 3-agent council autopilot. Mirrors COUNCIL.md; if they disagree, COUNCIL.md and this file must be reconciled together in the same change. Risk tier (risk_elevating_path_patterns) and human-only escalation (human_only_path_patterns, human_only_escalation_conditions, explicit PR/issue human_only_reason) are deliberately separate: an ordinary workflow/CI/content path change elevates risk and requires council review, it does not by itself stop autonomous progress.

resume_precedence_notes.unfinished_pr_excludes_duplicate_issue_p: An Issue with more than one open PR is never resolved under 'unfinished_pr': picking any single one of its PRs to act on (fix CI, request review, etc.) would be silently choosing a winner among duplicates, which single_owner_rule forbids. Those PRs are skipped in the unfinished_pr step and fall through to 'duplicate_or_stale_active', which must detect and flag them before any of that Issue's PRs is ever individually resolved.

risk_elevating_path_patterns.note: CI/CD pipeline change; requires council review before merge. Not automatically human-only unless it also touches secrets/permissions config (see human_only_path_patterns / explicit human_only_reason).
Changes the autopilot's own policy; requires council review before merge.
